_meta.description: Hand-authored edge-case pack complementing the 10 official public samples: directive-merge rules, window edge cases, an interpretation-ambiguity regression, an all-distractor scenario, and a battery boundary state. hourly_plan/totals are generated and self-validated by the project's own optimizer, not hand-computed; directive_interpretation is hand-authored.

cases.label: Overlapping solar_reduction: more-restrictive factor wins

operator_notes: Panel washing from noon until 2 PM will leave usable solar at about 50% of forecast.
Separately, inverter recalibration from 1 PM to 3 PM will cut usable solar to 20% of forecast.

directive_interpretation.explanation: Usable solar cut to 50% during hours [12, 13].
Usable solar cut to 20% during hours [13, 14].

cases.rationale: Two notes cut solar in overlapping hours with different severity. Guardrails must report each note's own window/factor untouched (one entry per note) while the ENGINE applies the more restrictive (lower) factor per hour: 0.5 at hour 12, min(0.5,0.2)=0.2 at hour 13 (both windows), 0.2 at hour 14.

cases.label: Overlapping minimum_battery_reserve: more-restrictive (max) reserve wins

operator_notes: Keep at least 40% of battery capacity in reserve from 6 PM to 9 PM for the campus radio relay.
A VIP evening event additionally requires at least 120 kWh reserved from 8 PM to 11 PM.

cases.rationale: Two reserve directives overlap at hour 20. percent_of_capacity 40% of 220 kWh = 88 kWh (hours 18-20); a flat 120 kWh reserve (hours 20-22) is stricter. The engine must take the per-hour max: 88 at 18-19, max(88,120)=120 at 20, 120 at 21-22.

cases.label: Overlapping no_charge_window: union of hours, not intersection

operator_notes: The primary charger will be offline from 2 AM to 5 AM for scheduled maintenance.
A separate feeder fault will also block charging from 4 AM to 6 AM.

cases.rationale: Two independent maintenance windows both forbid charging, hours 2-4 and 4-5, overlapping only at hour 4. The engine must block charging on the UNION {2,3,4,5}, not just the shared hour.

cases.label: Overlapping max_grid_window: more-restrictive (min) cap wins

operator_notes: Feeder A substation work limits grid import to 60 kWh from 2 AM to 5 AM.
Feeder B separately caps grid import at 50 kWh from 3 AM to 6 AM.

directive_interpretation.explanation: Grid capped at 60.0 kWh during hours [2, 3, 4].
Grid capped at 50.0 kWh during hours [3, 4, 5].

cases.rationale: Two feeders cap grid import over overlapping early-morning windows (chosen so the caps stay feasible given max_discharge_kwh_per_hour=50 and zero solar at night: demand-50 is the loosest possible cap per hour). The engine must take the per-hour minimum: 60 at hour 2, min(60,50)=50 at hours 3-4, 50 at hour 5.

cases.label: Bare hour-of-day without AM/PM must resolve from daytime context

operator_notes: Panel washing from one until three will leave roughly one-fifth of normal solar output.

directive_interpretation.explanation: Usable solar cut to 20% during hours [13, 14].

cases.rationale: Regression case for a real bug found in manual testing: 'from one until three' has no explicit AM/PM, and the LLM (Groq openai/gpt-oss-120b at temperature 0) was observed resolving it to 1-3 AM instead of 1-3 PM despite the daytime-only activity ('panel washing', 'solar output') that should disambiguate it. This case pins the correct reading so a prompt regression is caught by --base-url mode.

cases.label: Window edge cases: 'until midnight' (end=24) and a single-hour window

operator_notes: Grid import will be capped at 60 kWh from 11 PM until midnight for a controlled test.
No charging is allowed at 3 AM for a one-hour relay test.

directive_interpretation.explanation: Grid capped at 60.0 kWh during hours [23].

cases.rationale: 'From 11 PM until midnight' must resolve to end_hour=24 (exclusive), i.e. only hour 23 -- not an empty or out-of-range window. 'At 3 AM for a one-hour test' is a single-hour window [3].

cases.label: All three notes are distractors (no_op)

operator_notes: The registrar's office moved next semester's add/drop deadline by two days.
Facilities repainted the lines in the west parking lot over the weekend.
The cafeteria will switch to a new lunch vendor starting next month.

directive_interpretation.explanation: This note does not affect today's electricity schedule.
This note does not affect today's electricity schedule.
This note does not affect today's electricity schedule.

cases.rationale: Every note is about something other than today's 24-hour electricity schedule. All three entries must be applies=false / no_op / null, and the plan must equal the unconstrained cost-optimal schedule (no directives applied).

cases.label: Battery starts exactly at its own minimum (boundary state)

operator_notes: The facilities newsletter will go out later this week.

directive_interpretation.explanation: This note does not affect today's electricity schedule.

cases.rationale: initial_energy_kwh == minimum_energy_kwh == 40, so E[h] >= minimum must hold from hour 0 onward with zero slack at the start, and end-of-day neutrality (E[23] == 40) must still be met exactly. Pure boundary/precision check, independent of any directive.
